verdict.rationale: Brave documents an LLM Context endpoint that returns "pre-extracted page content for your LLM — no scraping, token-budgeted", with configurable token and URL limits and relevance thresholds. That clearly goes beyond the short snippets of standard Web Search, and extra snippets add up to 5 more excerpts per result. However, the evidence never says the endpoint returns the complete page text or a markdown format. The token-budgeted, threshold-filtered framing suggests it returns selected extracts rather than whole pages. Missing for 10: explicit full-page text retrieval, markdown output format, response-schema details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
